fork_number_rule: r24 (RELEASE-v1), r25 and r26 (GTJUDGE-v1) already exist; next free number r27
switch: --jbgs_trainlog {off,on}; off = r23 FinalTrain path unchanged; on = TrainLog(FinalTrain) recording only

target.change_vs_original: same argv as original command.json plus --jbgs_trainlog on (launch.train_args), as the B173 run; output under the case root

scope.ground_rule: PROCFIG-v1 freeze.py rule: survey DTM 0.5 m cell at the case-box XY centre; no LoD2 Z

save_rule.opacity_reset: every actual opacity reset: <it>_pre_reset = just before reset_opacity in that iteration (after its densify/prune); post = end of that iteration (<it>)

training_log.phase: end of iteration: after Adam update, 100-step reattach, densify/prune, opacity reset and final project_bounds (same point as jbgs_complete capture)
training_log.state_zero: after r23 initialization and training_setup, before first iteration (not reconstructed)
training_log.derived_columns: PROCFIG-v1 measure.py rules (normal, wall, current_patch, judgment, initial_patch, group33, target_xyz, target_sigma, normal_offset) computed on CPU from saved columns
training_log.scene_dump_note: full scene raw parameters at every saved state (torch.save), rendered after training

uid_rules.uid: int64, initial arange, children next_uid++, never reused
uid_rules.born_how: 0 patch seed, 1 initial background, 2 clone, 3 split

events.birth: iteration, seq, uid, parent_uid, how, parent tag, xyz, scale, parent xyz, parent scale (only children inside scope at birth)
events.delete: iteration, seq, uid, reason (1 opacity<min_opacity, 2 world size >0.1*extent, 3 screen size >max_screen, 4 other, 5 split parent replaced), flags bitmask (1 opacity,2 world,4 screen), opacity, scale, tag (only rows inside at last range check)
events.release: r24 Release.record fields + cause (0 density control, 1 100-step) + inside; classification case A/B by exact tangent search on CPU after training (RELEASE-v1 event_report.py rule)
events.retarget: bound before and after reattach with changed target_index, inside: uid, old, new valid-target index, cause; judgments and target height difference on CPU
events.range: end of every iteration (and before each opacity reset): uid, enter(1)/exit(0)

unit_checks.example: real scene B173nb_b10 x ALS, seed 0, 300 iterations; probe-only schedule --densify_from_iter 100 --opacity_reset_interval 200 (densify/prune at 200 and 300, opacity reset at 200, screen-size pruning at 300); saves every 50 + pre-reset
unit_checks.decision_invariance: on vs off: counts, tags, bound patches equal; xyz/scale/opacity byte-equal. If not byte-equal (nondeterministic CUDA atomics), report max difference and show max|on-off| <= max|off_a-off_b| and <= max|on_a-on_b| per quantity
unit_checks.self_check: r27_on_b runs with JBGS_TRAINLOG_SELFCHECK=1: model sums, tags, counts and python/torch/cuda RNG identical before and after each end-of-iteration record
unit_checks.id_tracking: child parent_uid points to a uid alive at birth; deleted uid never reappears; uid unique within each state
unit_checks.event_balance: conservation equation between every consecutive pair of states
unit_checks.same_as_r23: r27_off vs r23 under the same rule as decision_invariance

time_rule.reference: original curve.jsonl elapsed_seconds per 100 iterations (174.7 ms/it overall)
time_rule.measure: new curve seconds_per_iteration and wall time; if >1.5x, try batching (decision-neutral); if still >1.5x stop and ask

renders.mode: scene state dumped at each saved iteration, rendered after training with r23 renderer (FINALTRAIN rfix_speed .so, guard 0.5)

view_camera.projection: perspective, distance 500 m along -forward from scope box centre, horizontal FOV = 2*atan(ortho_width/2/500), ortho_width as PROCFIG (max(span_x,span_y*W/H)*1.08)

training_images.rule: largest fraction of case-1 GT rows inside building scope (PROCFIG camera-ranking population) visible unoccluded: projects inside image, in front, and no original 30,000 mesh hit closer than distance-0.15 m

outputs: normal (2DGS rend_normal, world) + fixed-light shaded image

mesh.rule: RESCORE-v1 addendum3 result mesh: 203 training views, TSDF 0.05/0.25 m, depth_trunc 300, bounded merge, 50 largest components, evaluation-rectangle crop; via GTJUDGE mesh_job.py render/prepare/plan/tile/merge/finish
mesh.scorer: GTJUDGE score_new.py + addendum11 rule (completeness: normal lines |s|<=tau; accuracy: normal_cylinder_1m) -> four cases 0,1,2,4 + scene; case 1 = 사전 정보 오류
mesh.timing_rule: time one key-iteration mesh first; if <=10 min mesh all saved iterations else key iterations only
mesh.ply_source: key iterations: scene dump converted with GaussianModel.save_ply; 30,000 comparison also from point_cloud/iteration_30000 as original
mesh.vertex_error: signed distance of each mesh vertex to nearest dense GT point (GTJUDGE reference dense.npz), sign by GT normal oriented nz>=0 (up +)
mesh.strip_extra: c1 1 m strip completeness from row distances (addendum6 strip_row_ids) as extra column

lineage.key: PROCFIG-v1 attribution.py: per training view (203) max alpha*T id (TARGET r5 maxid .so), GT rows of groups 1 and 2 projected to nearest pixel, |rendered depth - point camera depth|<=0.25 m, mode over views, ties lowest id
lineage.other: union of per-pixel max alpha*T ids in the two training images = 면을 그리는 가우시안
lineage.depth_gate: rfix depth used for the 0.25 m test; maxid surf_depth difference recorded

definitions.correction_site: 0회 상태에서 판정 보정(judge_region 2) & 벽 아님 & 묶인 씨앗의 목표 점 = 기준 목표면; 수평 거리 0.25 m 안 = 보정 자리 위
definitions.distance: 목표 점 수평 0.5 m 안 기준 목표 점(>=5)으로 평면 SVD, 부호 있는 법선 거리(위 +); 5개 미만이면 수직 거리
definitions.site: 묶임=묶인 패치 판정; 아니면 수평 0.35 m·높이 0.5 m 안 가장 가까운 0회 목표 점 판정, 없으면 가까운 목표 없음
definitions.band: 30,000회 보정 자리 위 묶이지 않은 것이 가장 많은 폭 1 m 띠 (제2 주축 v, 1 m 구간 최빈)

tables.per_state: PROCFIG building_counts + filling_intervals + wrong_patch_lineage columns; plus correction-site bound/unbound counts, interval-in, tau-in, below/above tau fractions, distance median, opacity median, long/short axis medians

fate.ga: wrong-lineage initial seeds (group33=1) and descendants: cumulative deletions by reason, released alive, bound alive, exited; opacity trajectory (median, p25, p75) before deletion; within old roof z±0.5 m before deletion
fate.na: 30,000 (and 15,000) unbound tau-in on correction site: ① existed at 7,000 and tau-out, ② existed at 7,000 and tau-in, ③ born after 7,000 (parent tau-in at birth or not); counts and drawing share (key lineage, 30,000 only)
fate.da: release events by interval (<=100,101-600,601-3000,3001-7000,7001-15000,>15000) x case x birth x cause; weights: events, 30,000 descendants, correction-site descendants
fate.ra: correction-site bound counts per saved iteration, births (clone/split), deletions by reason, opacity reset marks
fate.ma: long, short, ratio medians per saved iteration for bound and unbound

trajectories.rule1: wrong-lineage initial seed inside case box (addendum10 c1_boxes panel1) that lived longest (tie smallest uid)
trajectories.rule2: ① with largest 30,000 drawing share; else ① with smallest |distance| at 30,000
trajectories.rule3: initial background alive at 30,000 on correction site within tau, smallest uid

figures.layout: top: surface (wide) | section; middle: inner disks | trajectories; bottom: curves; legend row

inner.camera: PROCFIG rank-1 (az 180, el 35, orthographic), common extent over all frames

surface.color: signed vertex distance: |d|<=tau light grey, >tau red (above), <-tau blue (below), range ±1 m fixed

section.clip: values outside drawn on end rows
section.surface_line: key: mesh section; other: two training-image depth back-projected to band

curves.left: case-1 completeness/accuracy at key iterations; lines: 판단만 66.6, LGDM 73.4/78.1, GeoGS 79.1/49.3, 원래 판 98.8/72.5
curves.right: median depth error of two training images vs GT; tau-in of drawing gaussians (dark) and all (pale)
curves.marks: current iteration line, densify interval shade, opacity-reset ticks

figures.text: panel names, axes, legend, iteration only; no interpretation
